sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Black Swan is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, mercenary. I've been asking myself the same question all day: why does no one notice the obvious patterns in platinum price fluctuations? A crisis is coming, and they keep calling me a pessimist... That's alright. We'll see how much they're willing to pay for platinum once the prices go through the roof. I need to prepare. There are old heat exchangers scattered across Tarkov, and they still contain Soviet-era corrugated tubing with platinum inserts. Would you help me replenish my reserves? Just mark the heat exchangers with strobes, and I'll pay you well."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must reach Loyalty Level 2 with Mechanic to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Locate and mark any of the heat exchangers with an MS2000 Marker on Factory

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
"The marker is in place? Good. That'll make preparing for the crisis much easier."

sections.heading: Initial Equipment
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Notes |
| MS2000 Marker | 1 | This item is placed on the heat exchanger. When placed, the item is removed from the players' inventory. |

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in Raid | Notes |
| MS2000 Marker | 1 | Required | N/A | This item is placed on the heat exchanger. When placed, the item is removed from the players' inventory. |
In this quest you have to find and mark 1 of 3 possible heat exchangers in the underground tunnels on Factory with an MS2000 Marker.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- You can buy additional MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
- It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
- The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work
